bio.short: I prototype in real code, because a prototype that runs is the one that decides: at Bibel TV, engineering at an external agency ships from my Claude Code prototypes, reusing about half of the prototype code directly. My AI interaction design shipped with a measured lift of +153% and +85% weekly starts, and a one-week scrappy prototype I led at Spreadshirt reached production and shifted company strategy. Kotlin/Jetpack Compose, Swift on iOS, React.
bio.long:
At Bibel TV I am the only in-house designer, and I hold product manager, product owner and design for the consumer app redesign across iOS, Android, web and connected TV. I prototype in Claude Code against production APIs — web first, then native Kotlin/Jetpack Compose — and the external engineering agency ships from that code, reusing about half of it directly. Under the same roof sits a four-tier design-token architecture whose production rails run through Storybook.

The AI interaction design has shipped twice with outcomes attached. The entry point of the AI feature I designed full scope went from an unclear button to a self-explaining input, and weekly starts moved +153% on iOS and +85% on Android (GA4, four-week averages). A support copilot drafts replies for the viewer-services team with every send decision staying human, and the prompt-to-database onboarding I designed for Ninox with the CEO and technical co-founder shipped as their public AI beta in February 2026.

The range runs scrappy to polished: at Spreadshirt, a one-week Axure research prototype I led went to production and shifted company mobile strategy — the prototype was the argument that decided it. Around the work itself: Director of Design at Datameer, three Head-of roles since 2023, and a decade mentoring designers.

context.company: Apple — Interaction Architecture (IA), a design and prototyping team exploring future experiences; this role is London-based
context.emphasis: The prototype as decision instrument: real code, production APIs, open-ended briefs carried to a running artifact. Scrappy-to-polished range with named proofs. AI interaction design with measured outcomes rather than adjectives. He builds the work himself — Claude Code, Kotlin/Compose, Swift — and engineering ships from it across a company boundary.
